Phosphor icons (https://phosphoricons.com), MIT License. Used by the SVG specs only.
`gradient.svg` is written for these specs in the shape Figma exports (href-chained gradients in `defs`).
`sprite.svg` (a symbol sprite sheet drawn by `use`) and `clipped.svg` (a clipPath around artwork, as
Illustrator exports it) are written for these specs too.
